name: Storm Rune — Prophetic State
desc: As a Bonus Action, you enter a prophetic state for 1 minute or until you are Incapacitated. While in this state, when you or another creature you can see within 60 feet of you makes an attack roll, a saving throw, or an ability check, you can take a Reaction to give the roll Advantage or Disadvantage. Once per Short or Long Rest (twice from level 15, Master of Runes).
